data.narrative:
Endurosat is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $167M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 7 private peers at similar or adjacent stages—including Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Impulse Space ($4.3B Series D), and Apex Space ($2.3B Series D)—alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two valuation methods are applicable. The Stage-Progression approach uses total capital raised ($200M proxy) and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $340M. The Peer-Median method anchors to the 7-company private comparable set, which exhibits a median valuation of $2.0B and a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied: while the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S is 24.6x across the five public tickers, Endurosat's revenue is not disclosed, precluding a revenue-multiple approach.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $289M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median point of $1.2B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Endurosat's position relative to the peer set: peers range from $1.15B to $8.0B, and the stage-progression method mechanically produces a lower result than peer comparables. Key sensitivities include revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and technical risk in hardware deployment—none of which are fully resolved by available data.
